 Cape was founded in early 2022 by Palantir and Anduril alums with deep expertise in privacy and national security.  At Cape, we are not just another cellular service provider; we are the architects of a privacy\-centric movement that starts with the devices in your pocket.  The Role
   

  

 Cape’s platform gives customers end\-to\-end control of their digital identity, optimizing for resiliency, privacy, and security at every turn. We’re transforming how customers sign up, use, and think about their mobile phones and the privacy implications associated with it. Customers are protected at every level of the communications stack – from the mobile device, through contested infrastructure, to the core of the network itself.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer at Cape, your mission is to provide connectivity without compromise. Your charge is to build a system that enables resilient, global connectivity with a security \& privacy first mind\-set that separates our users from the legacy telecom ecosystem.  We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real\-world problems, personal privacy, and empowering peers to be autonomous. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, highly performant, and scalable systems, and to design robust APIs and primitives, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them. Your day\-to\-day will constantly change and be filled with ambiguity, but everything you work on has a high impact.
